oidcc-client-test-idtoken-sig-none.note: The BFF rejects unsigned ID tokens, which the suite accepts.

oidcc-client-test-userinfo-bearer-body.note: The BFF sends the access token in the Authorization header (RFC 6750 2.1), and the module expects it in the body.

oidcc-client-test-distributed-claims.note: The BFF does not fetch distributed claims, which are optional (OIDC Core 5.6.2).
